title: 口语中的常见语法错误
goal: 结合主语、时间、数量和指代修正口语句子，并保留原有信息。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 改正主谓一致和单复数的错误
改正时态、冠词和语序的错误

body.p: 改语法时，先确定原意，再改必要的形式。My tutor explain it every week. 的主语是单数，时间是习惯，应改为 My tutor explains it every week。不能把时间改成过去来回避主谓一致。
he 和 she 按前面已经提到的人来选。间接问句保留疑问词，从句用陈述语序：写 I know where she works.，不写 I know where does she work。

cards.title: 主谓一致与单复数
rows: 第三人称单数
My cousin work near campus.
My cousin works near campus.
一般现在时单数主语用 works。
第三人称单数
The tutor don't teach on Friday.
The tutor doesn't teach on Friday.
doesn't 后接原形 teach，不再加 -s。
规则复数
We need three chair.
We need three chairs.
three 后接可数名词复数。
不规则复数
Two childs joined the group.
Two children joined the group.
child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。
不可数名词
The information are useful.
The information is useful.
information 不可数，谓语用 is。
主语中心词
The list of tasks are short.
The list of tasks is short.
主语中心词是 list，不是 tasks。

cards.title: 时态与冠词
rows: 已结束的过去
Last Saturday, I visit the campus.
Last Saturday, I visited the campus.
有明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。
过去进行时
I am waiting when the bus arrived.
I was waiting when the bus arrived.
arrived 发生在过去，正在进行的动作用 was waiting。
首次提及
I joined club last term.
I joined a club last term.
单数可数名词第一次提到时，前面加 a。
元音起始
It was a unusual experience.
It was an unusual experience.
unusual 以元音开头，前面用 an。
再次提及
I bought a guide. A guide had a map.
I bought a guide. The guide had a map.
再次指同一本 guide 用 the。
辅音起始
It was an useful session.
It was a useful session.
useful 以 /j/ 开头，前面用 a。

cards.title: 代词与间接问句
rows: he 误指女性
My aunt runs a cafe. He opens it early.
My aunt runs a cafe. She opens it early.
前面说的是 aunt，用 she。
she 误指男性
My uncle repairs clocks. She works at home.
My uncle repairs clocks. He works at home.
前面说的是 uncle，用 he。
where 从句
I know where is the workshop.
I know where the workshop is.
where 后面先主语、后谓语。
when 从句
She asked when did the talk begin.
She asked when the talk began.
去掉 did，用 began 表示过去。
whether 从句
I wonder whether does it open today.
I wonder whether it opens today.
whether 后仍用陈述语序。
主语疑问词
I know who she runs the club.
I know who runs the club.
who 就是从句的主语，后面不再加主语。

body.box:
Notes: The speaker's sister manages a repair shop now. The speaker does not know its current closing time.
Draft: My sister manage the shop. He is the manager. I don't know when does it close.
My sister manages the shop. She is the manager. I don't know when it closes.

body.p: sister 是单数主语，manage 改为 manages。第二句仍指 sister，He 改为 She。when 从句改成 when it closes，时间仍是现在。
改正不能改变已知事实。把 sister 改为 brother，虽然和 He 一致，却换了人物。notes 写的是 manages a repair shop now，也不能改成过去时。

groups.text: Notes: One coach leads practice every Tuesday. Draft: The coach lead practice every Tuesday.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the subject and routine?
options: The coaches lead practice every Tuesday.
The coach leads practice every Tuesday.
The coach led practice last Tuesday.
The coach will lead practice next Tuesday.
items.why: One coach 是单数，every Tuesday 表示习惯，所以用 leads，即第二项。

groups.text: Notes: Exactly four visitors arrived. Draft: Four visitor arrived at the office.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the recorded number?
options: A visitor arrived at the office.
Four visits took place at the office.
Four visitors arrived at the office.
The fourth visitor left the office.
items.why: 依据是 Exactly four visitors arrived，visitor 改为复数 visitors，即第三项。第二项把人换成了 visits。

groups.text: Notes: A student has two younger brothers. Draft: My two brother attend the same school.

items.stem: Which correction keeps the family relationship and number?
options: My two brothers attend the same school.
My younger brother attends two schools.
My two sisters attend the same school.
My second brother teaches at the school.
items.why: 依据是 two younger brothers，brother 改为复数 brothers，即第一项。

groups.text: Notes: The only museum guide does not work on Sundays. Draft: The guide don't work on Sundays.

options: The guides don't work on Sundays.
The guide works only on Sundays.
The guide didn't work last Sunday.
The guide doesn't work on Sundays.
items.why: The only museum guide 是单数，don't 改为 doesn't，即第四项。

groups.text: Notes: The speaker's aunt teaches chemistry. Draft: My aunt teaches chemistry. He enjoys the laboratory classes.

items.stem: Which revision keeps the person unchanged?
options: My uncle teaches chemistry. He enjoys the classes.
My aunt teaches chemistry. She enjoys the classes.
My aunt teaches chemistry. Her uncle enjoys the classes.
My aunt and uncle both teach the laboratory classes.
items.why: 前一句说的是 My aunt，He 应改为 She，即第二项。

groups.text: Notes: The speaker bought a single umbrella for the first time in this account. Draft: I bought a umbrella.

options: I bought several umbrellas.
I borrowed an umbrella.
I bought an umbrella.
I bought an umbrella stand.
items.why: umbrella 以元音开头，a 改为 an，即第三项。第四项多了 stand，换了物品。

groups.text: Notes: The speaker attended a rehearsal yesterday. Draft: Yesterday I attend the rehearsal.

options: Yesterday I attended the rehearsal.
Every day I attend the rehearsal.
Tomorrow I will attend the rehearsal.
I have never attended the rehearsal.
items.why: Yesterday 表示过去，attend 改为 attended，即第一项。

groups.text: The speaker wants to ask indirectly about the location of an office.

items.stem: Which sentence embeds the location question correctly?
options: Could someone tell me where is the office?
Could someone tell me where does the office be?
Could someone tell me where the office does?
Could someone tell me where the office is?
items.why: 间接问句里 where 后面先接主语 the office，再接 is，即第四项。

lines.text: My supervisor checks the inventory before each delivery.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: My supervisor 是单数主语，习惯动作用 checks。

lines.text: The two volunteers carry the boxes into the storeroom.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: two volunteers 是复数主语，动词用 carry。

lines.text: I bought an inexpensive recorder for the project.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: inexpensive 以元音开头，前面用 an。

lines.text: The coordinator asked where the extra cables were.

items.stem: Rebuild the sentence that was heard.
items.why: where 从句用陈述语序：the extra cables were。

groups.text: Notes: One assistant regularly checks every returned key. Draft: The assistant check every returned key.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the routine and the number of assistants?
options: The assistant checks every returned key.
The assistants check every returned key.
The assistant checked a returned key yesterday.
The assistant will check a returned key tomorrow.
items.why: One assistant 是单数，regularly 表示习惯，所以用 checks，即第一项。

groups.text: Notes: Exactly three children took part in the puppet workshop. Draft: Three child took part in the puppet workshop.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the participant count?
options: The third child watched the puppet workshop.
Three children participated in the puppet workshop.
Three childhood workshops were held for participants.
One child took part in three puppet workshops.
items.why: 依据是 Exactly three children took part。child 的复数是 children，participated 是 took part 的同义改写，即第二项。

groups.text: Notes: The speaker's uncle is a photographer. The speaker says, 'My uncle takes portraits. She works in a small studio.'

items.stem: Which correction keeps the same person and workplace?
options: My aunt takes portraits. She works in a small studio.
My uncle takes portraits. His sister works in the studio.
My uncle takes portraits. He works in a small studio.
My uncle takes portraits. They both work in large studios.
items.why: 第二句指的是前面的 My uncle，She 改为 He，即第三项。

groups.text: Notes: The speaker completed the registration last night. Draft: Last night I complete the registration.

items.stem: Which correction retains the completed past event?
options: Each night I complete the registration.
Tonight I will complete the registration.
I have not completed the registration yet.
Last night I completed the registration.
items.why: Last night 是过去时间，complete 改为 completed，即第四项。
